{{Top|leg}}
A '''functional constituency''' was a cultural or species enclave existing within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or a [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporation]] with holdings in Republic space that was directly represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by a dedicated [[Senator/Legends|Senator]].

==History==
Among a great many alterations made to the organization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the aftermath of the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] reduced the number of constituent [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] from millions to 1,024 in total,<ref name="TCSWEIII117">{{CSWECite|III|117|Ruusan Reformations}}</ref> each of which enjoyed representation in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] and series of [[Junior Representative/Legends|Associate Planetary Representatives]]. However, a loophole in the relevant legislation permitted the extension of direct representation to so-called "functional constituencies," designated special zones and districts of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> that together constituted distinct cultural or [[Species/Legends|species]] enclaves. Like the sectors in which they were situated, these functional constituencies were represented in the Senate by dedicated Senators of their own.<ref name="TCSWEIII117" />

Over the course of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]], [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporations]] increasingly absorbed Republic member worlds into their corporate holdings as ''de facto'' possessions,<ref name="TEA" /> effectively denying their denizens representation in the Galactic Senate. In an effort to address this issue, the Senate reclassified such megacorporations as functional constituencies in a series of reforms introduced in [[124 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> granting them representation in the Senate. The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] was among those megacorporations granted this status in 124 BBY and promptly used its new representation to buy large blocs of votes from other less-wealthy sectors. By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Trade Federation-controlled bloc was the largest voting body in the Senate.
